/**
 * @name Use of subprocess module
 * @description Detects any use of the subprocess module (manual review for shell usage)
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity note
 * @id py/subprocess-usage-generic
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-078
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::moduleImport("subprocess").getAMember().getACall()
select call, "Use of subprocess module; review arguments for potential shell usage or command injection risk."
findings.hypothesis: Package may use subprocess in a risky way; first locate all subprocess calls for manual/secondary analysis.
